newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares recover slightly, close higher.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares recover slightly, close higher.

text.p: Delhi stocks staged a small recovery to close higher on Tuesday, fuelled by increased purchases by domestic and foreign investors, brokers said.
The Delhi Stock Exchange's benchmark index rose 7.02 points to close at 898.58 points.
"The market should bounce back if the uncertainties at the centre are cleared," said Manoj Choraria of brokers Choraria Investments (Pvt) Ltd.

Traders said foreign players, who sold on Monday following a regional party's announcement that it plans to pull out of the United Front government, extended their support to some fundamentally strong stocks.
The Delhi bourse's benchmark index closed 3.3 percent lower at 891.56 points on Monday after the announcement, but recovered on Tuesday.
Reliance Industries rose three rupees to 351, after reaching 352.35 in early trade.
State Bank of India rose 7.10 rupees to 345.10 as foreign investors made sizeable purchases.
Hero Honda Motors Ltd rose 4.95 rupees to 609.95.
